{"metadata":{"description":"REA reverse-engineering tools for DeepSeek Harness, as a filtering MCP bridge","id":"gh:1415272146","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-rea","slug":"JeremyWangCY/dsh-rea","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","mcp","reverse-engineering"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"REA reverse-engineering tools for DeepSeek Harness, as a filtering MCP bridge"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-rea"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Full REA 6.8.0 MCP tools and its original version-matched skill for DeepSeek Harness. English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Lazy by default:** the 229 tool schemas and the skill stay out of a request until you run `/rea` —"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" 273,264 bytes per request saved in native mode (~171 KB in PTC) when they are not needed."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Lazy exposure (default since v0.4)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Tools and the skill are **per-agent lazily visible**; the protocol and the process do not change:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- The MCP connection, the single REA process, all six original prompts and completions are **always "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"live** — the `/` menu works whether or not a session has revealed the catalog.
- Each agent starts w"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ith a `tools.restrict({ deny })` mask naming every current `mcp__rea__*` tool. Native schemas and th"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"e generated PTC SDK prompt are both projected from the same scope view, so both lose the catalog tog"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ether.
- The skill is registered once at reveal time and released again when the last revealed sessi"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"on hides the catalog, so it costs nothing in sessions that never reveal — and stops costing anything"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" after `/rea off`.
- A bridge re-sync (`notifications/tools/list_changed`) rebuilds every mask, so a"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" new tool generation cannot slip through; agents that already revealed are never re-masked mid-task."},{"id":"p7s9","text":"
- A resumed session is judged from the `command/run` records already in its log: the records are re"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"played in order, so the last `/rea` or `/rea off` wins, `/rea status` records are ignored, and a ses"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"sion where you ran `/rea` yesterday is not hidden again today. An unreadable history means **hidden*"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"* — the catalogue is never revealed by accident."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### `/rea` is the switch; keywords are not"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The command reveals first, then queues everything after `/rea` as an **ordinary user message** — a r"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"esolved command never reaches the model, so not forwarding it would silently swallow your request."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`/rea off` re-masks the tools immediately and is durable across a reload: a session that ends hidden"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" stays hidden. It only affects the session that ran it."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Why not infer from keywords:** inference is a guess, and a wrong guess costs the whole catalog (53"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"0 KB in native mode). It is also wrong precisely where it is most expensive — discussing this gate n"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ecessarily names its trigger words. `/rea` is the user saying it outright."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A keyword path still exists, opt-in:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Return to the previous always-on catalogue:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Load only what you need (categories)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Revealing the whole catalog costs 273,264 bytes of model-side schema per request (REA 6.8.0 advertis"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"es compact input schemas by default; `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=full` makes it larger), and most "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"sessions need a slice of it. Every upstream tool belongs to exactly one **category**, and a session "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"can reveal only the categories it needs. Measured on REA 6.8.0 with `node verify/measure.mjs`:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Category | Tools | Model-side schema bytes |
|---|---:|---:|
| `native` | 76 | 92,276 |
| `android"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"` | 32 | 23,073 |
| `apple` | 13 | 11,423 |
| `managed` | 8 | 13,301 |
| `web` | 28 | 46,094 |
| `wa"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"sm` | 2 | 3,625 |
| `dynamic` | 24 | 29,218 |
| `providers` | 7 | 6,020 |
| `firmware` | 9 | 15,453 "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"|
| `capture` | 6 | 8,207 |
| `reconstruction` | 24 | 24,344 |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The rows add up to the catalog minus about 200 bytes of JSON array punctuation. `native` is the broa"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"d binary-analysis family and the largest, so a native-only session carries about 34% of the catalog "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"(about 66% less). A name no rule maps yet falls into `other`, which is loadable like any category, a"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nd `test/categories.test.mjs` fails on an REA bump that leaves any tool there."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A list with an unknown category is refused whole rather than half-applied, and `/rea on this binary`"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" is still a request (a word that is not a category keeps the input a request)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**The model can load categories itself, if you opt in.** With `modelLoader: true` (lazy exposure onl"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"y) the plugin registers two small tools, `rea_load({ categories })` and `rea_unload()`, named outsid"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"e the `mcp__rea__` prefix so the gate never hides them. `rea_load` reveals categories for the callin"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"g session only, accepts at most `loaderMaxPerCall` (default 3) *new* categories per call, does nothi"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ng when everything asked for is already loaded, and returns how many tools and KB the load added. Lo"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ading changes the request prefix and costs a prompt-cache miss, so the tool description tells the mo"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"del to load once per task. They are off by default, because they ride along with every request and l"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"et the model widen its own view without a `/rea`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What is preserved"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- All **229 upstream tools**, including navigation, decompilation, Android/ADB, managed code, JavaSc"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ript/Electron and runtime analysis. No invented entry/navigate/analyze tiers.
- Original input schem"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"as and descriptions, with stable DSH names `mcp__rea__<upstream-name>`.
- The official `@deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"/dsh-mcp-client` handles pagination, notifications, cancellation, lifecycle, output validation and a"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ttachment projection.
- Original `reverse-engineer-anything` skill, its upstream `tool_count` and al"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"l seven references. The plugin registers the package's skill with its own resource directory; it doe"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"s not overwrite Codex/user skills.
- Original stateful upstream MCP process and complete Evidence `c"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"ontent`/`structuredContent`. No result summaries or reconstructed IDs.
- All **six original MCP prom"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"pts** with their 25 arguments and the original dynamic completions, reachable from the composer's `/"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"` menu on the *same* REA Client, process and analysis session as the 229 tools."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"REA is an exact npm dependency, not a reimplementation. Native engines and commercial licenses remai"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"n bring-your-own, exactly as upstream."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Prompt templates in the `/` menu"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The six original prompts enter through the composer's own `/` menu, under the `rea` group (`/rea:inv"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"estigate_feature`, `/rea:compare_application_versions`, `/rea:verify_reconstruction`, `/rea:trace_cr"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ash`, `/rea:audit_residual_unknowns`, `/rea:prepare_bounded_process_capture`) — the surface a Codex "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"user already knows, where Codex exposes these same MCP prompts. **No extra button or permanent contr"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ol is added to the composer.**"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Picking an entry opens that template's argument form: the original argument descriptions, upstream a"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"rgument completions (target documents, providers, procedures, retained Evidence, captures, manifests"},{"id":"p30s3","text":", occurrences, unresolved unknowns) and an exact-text preview you can insert into the draft."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Fidelity rules of that panel:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
